claim.claim-text: 1. A method for use in a first node of a transport network for supporting latency monitoring in the transport network, the transport network transporting traffic to and from at least one wireless base station, the transport network comprising the first node and a second node, the method comprising:

2. The method according to claim 1, wherein the communication signal comprises a frame with an overhead and a payload, and the method adds (1404) the information representative of the first timestamp into the overhead part of the frame.

3. The method according to claim 2, wherein the indication of an association is a pointer, and the method comprises adding the pointer (1405) to an overhead part of the communication signal, the pointer pointing to a part of the payload where the data element is carried.
4. The method according to any of the claims 1 - 3, wherein the indication of an association comprises an identifier of a client link carried by the frame.
5. The method according to any of the claims 1 - 4, comprising: sending synchronisation information.

6. A method for use in a second node of a transport network for supporting latency monitoring in the transport network, the transport network transporting traffic to and from at least one wireless base station, the transport network comprising a first node and the second node, the method comprising:

7. The method according to claim 7, wherein the indication of an association comprises a pointer in an overhead part of the communication signal, the pointer pointing to a part of the payload where the data element is carried.

8. The method according to any of the claims 1 to 7, wherein the communication signal comprises a frame with an overhead and a plurality of payload areas into which signals/data can be mapped, the payload areas comprising one or more of:
a payload area for carrying Common Public Radio Interface, CPRI, signals; a payload area for carrying Ethernet signals.

9. An apparatus (1600) for supporting latency monitoring at a first node of a transport network, the transport network transporting traffic to and from at least one wireless base station, the transport network comprising the first node and a second node, the apparatus (1600) comprising a processing circuitry (1601) and a memory (1602), the memory (1602) containing instructions executable by the processing circuitry (1601) such that the apparatus (1600) is operative to:

10. The apparatus (1600) according to claim 9, wherein the communication signal comprises a frame with an overhead and a payload, and the apparatus (1600) is operative to add the information representative of the first timestamp into the overhead part of the frame.

11. The apparatus (1600) according to claim 10, wherein the indication of an association is a pointer, and the apparatus (1600) is operative to add the pointer to an overhead part of the communication signal, the pointer pointing to a part of the payload where the data element is carried.
12. The apparatus (1600) according to any of the claims 9 - 11 operative to use an identifier of a client link carried by the frame as the indication of an association.

13. An apparatus (1700) for supporting latency monitoring at a second node of a transport network, the transport network transporting traffic to and from at least one wireless base station, the transport network comprising a first node and the second node, the apparatus (1700) comprising a processing circuitry (1701) and a memory (1702), the memory (1702) containing instructions executable by the processing circuitry (1701) such that the apparatus (1700) is operative to:

14. The apparatus (1700) according to claim 13, wherein the indication of an association comprises a pointer in an overhead part of the communication signal, the pointer pointing to a part of the payload where the data element is carried.
15. The apparatus (1700) according to claim 14 operative to receive the indication of an association in advance of the information representative of the first timestamp.
